questions.q: Mary put the same amount of liquid in three rectangular vessels. Viewed from the front, they seem to have the same size, but the liquid has risen to different levels. Which of the following represents the three vessels when viewed from above? / Mary menuang jumlah cecair yang sama ke dalam tiga bekas kuboid. Dari hadapan, bekas-bekas itu kelihatan sama saiz, tetapi paras cecair berbeza. Antara berikut, yang manakah mewakili tiga bekas itu dari pandangan atas?
What does the object look like when viewed from above? / Apakah rupa objek berikut apabila dipandang dari atas?

Three small squares are drawn inside a larger square as shown. What is the length of the line marked with a question mark? / Tiga segi empat sama kecil dilukis di dalam satu segi empat sama yang lebih besar seperti dalam rajah. Berapakah panjang garis bertanda soal?

Nine tokens are black on one side and white on the other. Initially, four tokens have the black side upwards. In each turn you have to flip three tokens. What is the least number of turns you need to have all tokens showing the same colour? / Sembilan token mempunyai satu muka hitam dan satu muka putih. Pada mulanya empat token menunjukkan warna hitam. Setiap langkah, anda perlu menterbalikkan tiga token. Apakah bilangan langkah paling sedikit untuk menjadikan semua token menunjukkan warna yang sama?
Which of the following options will balance the third scale? / Antara pilihan berikut, yang manakah akan mengimbangi neraca ketiga?

Magnus has to play 15 games in a chess tournament. At some point during the tournament he has won half of the games he has played, lost one third of the games he has played, and drawn two games. How many games does Magnus still have to play? / Magnus perlu bermain 15 perlawanan dalam satu kejohanan catur. Pada suatu ketika, dia telah memenangi separuh daripada perlawanan yang telah dimainkan, kalah sepertiga daripadanya, dan seri dua perlawanan. Berapakah bilangan perlawanan yang belum dimainkan?

Vadim has a square piece of paper divided into nine cells. He folds the paper as shown: overlapping horizontally, and then vertically so that the grey square ends on top. He wants to write the numbers 1 to 9 into the cells so that, once the paper is folded, the numbers would be in increasing order with number 1 on the top layer. What numbers should he write instead of a, b and c? / Vadim mempunyai sekeping kertas segi empat sama dengan sembilan petak. Dia melipat kertas seperti yang ditunjukkan: mula-mula bertindih secara mendatar, kemudian menegak sehingga petak kelabu berada paling atas. Dia ingin menulis nombor 1 hingga 9 supaya apabila dilipat, nombor tersusun menaik dengan 1 paling atas. Apakah nombor yang harus ditulis pada petak a, b dan c?

Don builds a pyramid with balls. The square base consists of 3 × 3 balls, the middle layer has 2 × 2 balls, and there is one ball at the top. He puts glue at each contact point between two balls. How many glue points are there? / Don membina piramid menggunakan bola. Tapak segi empat sama terdiri daripada 3 × 3 bola, lapisan tengah 2 × 2 bola, dan satu bola di bahagian atas. Dia meletakkan gam pada setiap titik sentuhan antara dua bola. Berapakah bilangan titik gam?
